recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If strict alphabetic ordering of newer metadata types matters, handle it as a separate Kindling/TypesUtilities publisher cleanup or new human-reviewed tracker, not as a core source edit for FHIR-17839.
issue_request: FHIR-17839 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for the STU3 datatypes page asking to sort the open-type list and add sub-labels, especially for the metadata-types portion.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies GH#bb3cf76b52. Commit bb3cf76b52e925cfec03721272b075521bcdc8cf removed the outer <ul> around [%wildcard-type-list%] in source/datatypes.html, following dcd3ffda9020726ce3628f04603b19e4bf289c52 which had single-sourced the wildcard list token.
additional_context: Current source/datatypes.html still uses the unwrapped [%wildcard-type-list%] token in build scope, fhir.ini maps wildcard '*' to the datatypes page, and Kindling's PageProcessor renders headings by wildcard classification from TypesUtilities. Current CI output shows the requested Primitive Types, Datatypes, MetaDataTypes, and Special Types headings. Newer metadata-type additions are not strictly alphabetic in the hard-coded Kindling order, but that is a publisher/dependency cleanup rather than a core source reconciliation for this old applied issue. FHIR-26935 is a later, already-published usage-list fix on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that FHIR-17839 remains applied in current core source and that replacing the generator token with a manual list would reintroduce drift.
